title: Quake (svgalib)
subtitle: id Software, 1996 · the OTHER Linux driver: the console framebuffer, no X server
argsHint: the same arguments as the X11 build. `-mode G320x200x256` names the one mode this shim offers; any other would want a planar VGA, which is P3.5's problem.
_why: Not a different machine -- a different DISPLAY PATH on the same one. vid_svgalib.c draws to the virtual console's framebuffer and reads the raw keyboard, where vid_x.c talks to an X server; both are id's, both are Linux, and having both is what a Linux box in 1996 actually offered.
_planar: Its planar branch calls VGA_UpdatePlanarScreen, the one routine in this build with no C equivalent -- and it is never taken, because `VGA_planar = modes[current_mode].bytesperpixel == 0` and the default mode is a linear one.
